dates.flourished: 14th c. (contemporary of Sufi missionary activity in Kashmir)

name: Lalla (Lal Ded, Lalleshvari)
summary: Fourteenth-century Kashmiri mystic poetess: the Vakhyani (sayings) speak nondual recognition in the vernacular — jnana as direct tasting beyond book-learning. Language is Kashmiri, not Sanskrit; English via Hoskote (I, Lalla), Grierson-Barnett, Kaul. Included as the vernacular voice of the same recognition.
